scope: Exploratory development corpus: 51 fixtures, 123 cases, 3–14 logical qubits; seven measured trials per cell. Separate campaigns; ratios never pool sessions. Full raw outputs, protocols and analyses are retained in the accompanying investigation bundle.

method.cell_estimator: median of all prescribed trials; only complete validated cells eligible
method.aggregate_estimator: equal-cell-weight geometric mean of positive paired ratios
method.secondary_family_balanced_estimator: mean of within-family mean log ratios; equal weight for each family with positive ratios; interval resamples fixture clusters within fixed families

bootstrap.unit: fixture; all its topology cells remain together
bootstrap.interval: percentile 95%; no interval with fewer than two fixtures

method.zero_policy: zero ratios and zero denominators excluded from log/geomean summaries and counted separately; all pairs retained for win/tie/loss
method.timing: warm API compilation; parse+compile is secondary; process startup, imports, serialization and validation excluded
method.near_best: primary bands compare Q-Rust against the best of Qiskit/Cirq/TKET cell medians; all-four-complete cells only; at_best means at or better than best baseline; separate all-four ratios/bands also retained
method.scope: descriptive fixed-corpus comparison; no causal language-speed attribution or optimality claim
